title: fix(ui): explain pending requests in sidebar attention tooltips
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Sidebar attention icons say a session needs an answer or approval without explaining the request. Collapsed agent headers also hide their attention indicator when hover or keyboard focus reveals the action buttons.

## User Impact

Hover or keyboard-focus an attention icon to see the oldest pending question, compact command, or approval title, with a count of additional requests of the same kind. This works in the regular session list, Home, and the agent roster, including collapsed groups. Session rows remain compact, and collapsed-header attention stays accessible beside its actions.

## Why This Change Was Made

The browser already receives the request details. This change carries a bounded preview through the existing attention projection, preserves priority tiers, and uses creation order within the question/approval tier. Existing resolution and expiry events remove settled requests. Question previews read request text only; entered answers and credential drafts are excluded.

## Evidence

- Tested the running candidate in Chrome against an isolated real Gateway with synthetic sessions, question requests, and approval requests. Verified keyboard tooltips, additional-request counts, oldest-request selection, answering in the question card, cancellation, denial, and automatic expiry without reloading. No model calls or approved command execution were needed.
- Focused sidebar/approval tests and UI typecheck passed. After rebase: 478 sidebar/tree tests and 26 browser E2E cases across question flow, approval flow, Home attention, and sidebar geometry. Geometry covers four cases covering 258–334 px widths, light/dark themes, touch, keyboard access, and action overlap.
- CI exposed two older page-wide text selectors matching the new tooltip previews as well as their cards. Scoped the approval and Home-attention checks to the actual card/panel; both full suites pass locally (five tests), with their original behavior assertions preserved.
- A formatting-only fixture adjustment clears a max-lines lint error inherited from the rebased main; file-write options and test behavior are unchanged.
- Regression cases fail on the original code for missing details/counts and hidden collapsed attention. The full changed-file gate and production UI build passed, including type, lint, formatting, i18n, and bundle-budget checks. Independent review found no actionable issues through P2.
- [Exact-head CI passed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35023979778) on attempt 4. Runner-queue recovery retained completed results. The unchanged Node/SSH desktop proof and remaining real-Gateway suites passed on attempt 3; attempt 4 ran only the aggregate gate. The earlier SSH backend stream closure is the failure class tracked in [#147066](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/147066); its underlying cause remains unresolved.
